name: Athletica
body:
Author Phyllamus the Mighty, human, CN; Language Ancient Common
Alphabet Common; DC 16; Pages 154 Price 2,420 gp; Weight 4 lbs.

DESCRIPTION

Roughly half of this strength training manual consists of primitive sketches and crude diagrams describing exercises prescribed by the manual’s author, one of the greatest wrestlers in recorded history. A master of his craft, but not exactly the brightest individual, Phyllamus manual enjoys its popularity because of its simplicity and handiness. Gladiatorial schools, military camps and wrestling schools occasionally obtain a rare and coveted copy of this leather bound parchment manual. At the present time, approximately one hundred copies remain in circulation.

The reader receives a +2 insight bonus on all Acrobatics, Climb, and Swim skill checks.

MISINTERPRETATION

Misinterpretation The reader receives a -1 insight penalty on all Acrobatics, Climb, and Swim skill checks.

Gross Misinterpretation The character receives a -2 insight penalty on all Acrobatics, Climb, and Swim skill checks.
